literal: Fearlessness, generosity, wisdom, zeal, these four all, unfailingness, to a king, nature.
translation: Fearlessness, generosity, wisdom, and zeal—never lacking in these four is the nature of a king.
modern: அஞ்சாமை, ஈகை, அறிவு, ஊக்கம் ஆகிய இந்த நான்கு பண்புகளும் சிறிதும் குறையாமல் நிலைத்திருப்பது ஒரு அரசனுக்குரிய இயல்பாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the four essential qualities of a successful ruler. They are courage to face challenges, generosity to support the people, wisdom to make right decisions, and the drive to execute them. The word 'எஞ்சாமை' emphasizes that a true leader must possess all these four traits constantly and without any deficiency.
